method_limits: Same continuing root wrote the source-grounded model,designed all cases,composed the outputs and assessed them. All opposing variants and previous outputs were visible. No external responder or independent judge.
These are authored informed hypotheticals,not newly observed novel behavior. Strong explicit cues and generic alternatives sharply limit discrimination.
No elapsed speech timing,Japanese voice adequacy,unseen source prediction or durable transfer was validated. Compliant word count is only a format check.
Capacity and prompt-boundary fidelity are not counted as additional behavior wins; six texts are three dependent paired exercises,not independent trials.
All first text and receipts remain exact. Unsupported cosmetic/temporal rhetoric and blame displacement are retained in the receiving. The frozen model and inputs are unchanged.
All three rules have only narrow designed expressions; the full nine-category final simulation battery and final model maturity remain open.
